evidence_scope: participant-authored design-search evidence; not an organizer or statutory simulation
rights_scope: The wrapper, participant compiler and harness use COMMUNITY-DISPLAY-ONLY. The separately identified corridor, seven-room and Dazhongsi context parts retain their ODbL-1.0 source rights. Four separately identified 1909 album images retain their LOC/WDL item-level rights status and credit. This wrapper overrides none of those source rights.

direct_sun.method: NREL SPA through pinned pvlib; typed building/roof/tree layers; orientation-height-tree sensitivity

changeover.method: twelve City Task Contracts × normal/ambiguous/hard-stop fixtures; two independent keys; permanent H; deny-by-default rollback

claim_boundary.claim: No live model, live user, site operation, or field-performance run was executed; results establish design-time wiring only.

delivery_readiness.method: eleven Beijing urban-renewal implementation-plan modules; nine projects; twelve documentary gates held unless evidenced

claim_boundary.claim: The run verifies dossier structure, traceability and fail-closed emitted state inside an unsigned participant implementation-control template. Zero recorded transition counts do not prove the absence of real-world acts. The run does not prove a site, operator, price, permit, consultation, field result, professional approval, or permission to construct or open.

semantic_witness.method: one local BGE-M3 embedding batch over three topology descriptors and 36 hypothetical fixtures; B shadow-only; deterministic H hard-stop

claim_boundary.claim: One local design-time embedding shadow benchmark was executed over hypothetical fixtures. Participant-authored labels are not independent truth; no real user, personal data, site operation, deployment, field performance, model promotion, or chain-of-thought is claimed.

claim_boundary.reason: dependency installation and trusted extraction are intentionally left to the reviewer; submission HTML never executes participant code

technical_figure_render.method: PIL primitives, glyphs and linework are re-rasterised at native 3x coordinates; validator-safe RGB package derivatives are then created with BOX, never by metadata-only enlargement
technical_figure_render.a3_embedding: technical package derivatives remain above the official review resolution and are independently capped again at PDF placement

replay.extract: write each source_snapshots[].content_utf8 from the two source parts to source_snapshots[].path; copy corridor-context.json, corridor-room-figure-ground.json and dazhongsi-osm-context.json to their replay_source_path under the repository parent; retain the four hash-pinned loc-jingzhang-1909-*.jpg files in visual/assets or copy them to research/jingzhang-evidence-line
replay.sequence: tests -> harness -> changeover -> delivery -> semantic witness -> first build -> direct-sun -> final build -> official finalizer -> four-gate self-check
replay.timestamp_policy: explicit pinned UTC evidence epoch; wall-clock execution time is excluded from the hashed run identity
replay.verify: compare harness, direct-sun, model-swap, delivery and semantic-witness run identities plus every receipt/artifact hash with their submitted latest indexes
